reviews.review_title: Like Phantasy Star Online in VR
reviews.review_description: Knights of Fiona is a must play co-op JRPG on Quest that brings back vibes of playing Phantasy Star Online ! Great story, voice performances, as well as lots of options for different styles of gameplay.

First off I want to say that people who are rating this game 5 stars NEED to raise their standards. Combat is bland, animations are stiff. Everything has horrible graphics. Enemies are so weak even on hard mode. Sorry for everyone who pre ordered this game hoping it was going to be good, sorry you wasted your money. 

If your a developer and your reading this, maybe next time you should actually try to make a good game that people will like instead of this money wasting sorry excuse for a game. Do better.

reviews.review_title: Its a good game, but with flaws.
reviews.review_description:
I want to start by saying that CB's previous game Ruins Magus was a wonderful story telling game. Its presentation, the way it made me feel, and its story were top notch. That said gameplay left much to be desired. Additionally, the game received very little QoL updates and instead got a DLC that did nothing to fix the many issues that plagued what could have been one of the greatest games of its year.

I think Knights of Fiona is similar. I've played for about 2 hours or so and I can say that its more ambitious in scale. Its got elements of build crafting with weapons. Passive and active abilities which you can mix and match. It has a cool quest board system, a shop, a central hub, multiplayer, character customization, and far more. The character designs are awesome, the story so far is interesting, and the different weapons are unique enough to not be bland. However that's just about where my praise ends.
There is no ambient music in the reward screen, workshop, or item shop. Making for a very dead and very awkward area. As far as I can tell, if you pick the ENG voice, various texts and quips from characters cut short, advance far to fast, or bleed into each other as I assume the game's animations and pacing was originally intended for JP. Weapons are yet again weightless, making it feel like you're swinging around a paper bag. The weapons themselves are a little boring in direct playstyle. Some have unique abilities that make them cool but you've got a sword, a bow and a magic staff. I personally find the bow to be the most engaging and fun to use, because with both the sword and staff, you simply either wave your blade at foes, or point and click with the staff.  
The game is very rough around the edges. Many cutscenes load mid-cutscene. Multiple areas are half blank. Various screens and popups blur and re-appear in new locations, multiple hand positions for items are off, and more. 

Overall the game is good. But unpolished. It's also free. So....

developer_response.body:
Thanks for your feedback and for giving both RUINSMAGUS and Knights of Fiona a shot! With Knights of Fiona, the experience will only get better. With it being a live service title, we can keep tweaking and adjusting the experience based on the player's feedback. We have some plans that we will be sharing in the near future about what kind of things we are going to add / do in the near future.

With RUINSMAGUS, we felt that Grand Amnis was a place players went to once and couldn't return to. With Knights of Fiona we wanted to make Gallia a place where players can always return to, and that was one of the core design ideas we had going into this game. So I hope you play more Knights of Fiona and come back and enjoy the experience again in the future!!

reviews.review_title: This is not a JRPG at all!
reviews.review_description: Very misleading. Not a jrpg at all this is an arena fighter. There is ZERO world to explore. You select a mission from a board. You then spawn in a small arena environement. Fight the few creatures. Return to HUB area. That is all there is in this game. Some missions requires you to grind... i was level 3... my next mission required to be level 4... i grinded.. and the mission was to sit at a firecamp and listen to a story. Wha-? Super disapointing. The game is also "free" but you need to pay 25$ to unlock missions (more arenas).
We need more like this of its kind unfortunately the quality of meta games have died out but this was worth the wait hope to see more content on a large scale coming from this point on!!!

developer_response.body:
Thank you for the kind review!! We'll continue to make original games for VR :D

-Will

reviews.review_description:
When I was 10 years old, I had a certain nightmare where I fought monsters alongside my friends. The images were incredibly colorful and vivid, almost like a lucid dream, but I could never end the dream. It would only stop when I died.

The dream kept coming back for years, all the way until now. And then I realized this was the game I had been dreaming about for so many years.

Thank you for making my dream become reality. The best VR game ever.

After playing 2hrs i have reached level 5 with the 1st 3 lvls been part of the tutorial. Its got good mechanics for sword and shield but lacks on wand and pistol. The speech is clear and consistant and the game has many options. You can buy space from the meta store if you require an extra 50 spaces for weapons etc. The plaza area could of been more thought out  as its a bit janky. Overall its a nice game but the devs could of probably made  it better considering the talent that was used to create this.
I've played for a short amount of time but I would say it's a good game.
The game is so cuteeeee. Waited for so long for this game to launch! It has some bug here and there. But it's still pretty cool gameplay.
I pre-ordered this game at the discounted price and because it wanted me to download the base game first my preorder failed and now it just asks  for the full price. Is there anyway to rectify?
It would be amazing but the enemies are to easy and the fighting sucks tbh

developer_response.body: There are three difficulty levels, so please select a harder one! The easy mode is really for those who want to enjoy the story!!
